method: Activate the two NAE clauses for each triangle, extract an UNSAT triangle core, take its edge union, then greedily delete edges while exact edge-arrowing persists.
decision_reason: The exact source beta is 25 versus the required 9, the degree gate alone requires at least 247 edge deletions, every one-vertex deletion loses arrowing, and no first arrowing core completed within the bounded pulse.
claim_boundary: This does not prove that no edge-deleted subgraph of HoG 51171 is a counterexample. It is a resource-allocation gate, not an exhaustive subgraph result.
